text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO burn detected — p99 latency breach for streaming generation (eu-west-1). Rule: streaming_p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Affected route: /v1/stream/chat, model: redwood-xl/fp8-calib-v3, recent deploy: 6643218000.

sarah (oncall): I'm on it. paging ops and eng-ml. reading graphs now — thanks.

maria (ml-eng): saw the alert, joining. we rolled fp8-calib-v3 at 02:10 UTC to address throughput; telemetry shows occasional KV dequant stalls when context > 8k tokens, causing spikes.

noah (sre): confirm p95 ~ 300ms stable but p99 jumping to 2.2s intermittently, correlates with long-stream sessions (session_len > 4 minutes).

kevin (support): customer-facing note: two paying customers reported streaming stalls ~ 02:18 UTC, they saw frozen websocket frames then continued after ~3-4s. can provide logs.

maria (ml-eng): quick root-cause hypothesis: new fp8 calibration introduced a micro-serialization in the dequant path that deadlocks briefly under interleaved KV fetches. reproducing locally with synthetic trace.

noah (sre): can we mitigate without full rollback? options: 1) disable fp8 profile for streaming route (hot-config), 2) route long-context sessions to int8 fallback pool, 3) increase pod concurrency/scale.

sarah (oncall): prioritize customer impact and lowest blast radius. Option 1 + 2 seems safest. maria, can you drop fp8 for streaming now?

maria (ml-eng): running hot-config: PATCH /config/routes/streaming -> precision_profile: disallow: [fp8-calib-v3]

ops-bot: runbook step executed: updated runtime config, propagated to eu-west-1.

incident-bot: CONFIG CHANGE DETECTED by ops-bot at 6643219892. Monitoring for p99.

noah (sre): watching metrics — p99 dropped from ~2200ms -> 560ms within 90s. p95 unchanged.

kevin (support): sending interim message to customers: "We've identified a precision calibration issue that sporadically stalls streaming. We've applied a mitigation and are monitoring. No data loss; sessions should resume. We'll follow up with RCA." Want SLO-safe language?

sarah (oncall): good. send now. tag account owners.

kevin (support): message sent to AcmeCorp and LearnaAI + internal customer-impact channel. both confirmed temporary degradation but no major outage.

maria (ml-eng): follow-up: started a limited canary rollback of the calibration change (revert calibrations on 2 nodes) and collecting heap + kvcache traces. attaching quick log snippet: ```
[02:17:23] worker-7 WARN kvcache: blocked waiting for dequant lock (ctx_len=9216)
[02:17:24] worker-7 INFO dequant: resumed after 3100ms, tokens emitted=128
```

noah (sre): curious if this ties to interleaved requests to shared KV cache. i'm instrumenting cache metrics (hits, locks, contention).

maria (ml-eng): accepted — looks like lock contention spike aligns with p99 spikes. repro script: ```python
# repro: long stream + mixed batched prefix
client.stream(model='redwood-xl/fp8-calib-v3', context=10000)
```

sarah (oncall): handoff plan in 30m: if stable for 15m continue monitoring then hand to next oncall (noah). otherwise escalate to infra and rollback full deploy.

kevin (support): customers asked for ETA for full rollback — i'll say 1h if needed.

maria (ml-eng): next steps: 1) complete canary revert across eu-west (in progress), 2) add temporary route-level disallow for fp8 across long-context (>6k) sessions, 3) prepare full rollback artifact if canary shows insufficient improvement.

noah (sre): also enabling fallback routing: requests with header x-session-length > 6000 -> route to int8-pool-eu. patch applied.

incident-bot: MONITOR: p99 streaming latency trend updated -> 3min window p99=540ms, burn rate decreasing.

sarah (oncall): thanks team. please keep thread updated with any customer escalations. @kevin include any support tickets here. I'll mark as paging open until we hit 30m stable with p99 < 800ms.

kevin (support): added ticket #INC-4823 with customer logs. linking here: https://redwood.support/tickets/4823

maria (ml-eng): can we schedule a postmortem template? I'll start collecting calibration diffs and CI perf/lock traces.

sarah (oncall): yep — postmortem owner: maria. set sev: high (SLO breach). include timeline, telemetry, mitigation steps, customer impact.

noah (sre): final check: no visible increase in error rate or token loss. mainly tail latency. keeping autoscaling steady.

ops-bot: reminder: runbook window expires in 45m.

sarah (oncall): holding for handoff. last update: p99 steady ~530ms for 10m. moving to monitoring-only. handing to noah for overnight watch if stable.

noah (sre): acknowledged. I'll take over and watch eu-west and cross-check kvcache locks. if it reoccurs, i'll escalate to infra and trigger full rollback.

kevin (support): customer update sent: "Mitigation applied; latency normalized. We'll follow with RCA and timeline for permanent fix."

maria (ml-eng): collecting traces now. provisional root cause: calibration-induced lock in dequant path under long KV cache fetch patterns. RCA to follow.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED: paging moved to monitoring state at 6643219928.
